source.repro: Top-level features from `Gff3TabixAdapter`'s read sequence (`@gmod/tabix` getLines + `gff-nostream` parseRecordsLazy, overlap-filtered) over the shipped 2px probe window, sliding the sample point from 5% to 95% of each chromosome in 5% steps, against `https://jbrowse.org/genomes/GRCh38/ncbi_refseq/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_full_analysis_set.refseq_annotation.sorted.gff.gz`. Truth is every top-level feature on the chromosome over its width in px. Settling counts offsets meeting both of `settled`'s terms at DENSITY_SETTLE_FEATURES=8 and DENSITY_SETTLE_MARGIN=4.
source.notes: Why the settling exit confirms at a second point rather than answering from one window. At whole-genome zoom the verdict is robust to the offset (18-19/19), so the confirmation changes no verdict on real annotation data and costs one read on the refusing path; at whole-chromosome zoom it is offset-dependent, and a disagreement there drops back to the ladder, which is what ran before the exit existed. The spread is the argument: the shipped 25% point reads anywhere from 5% low to 2x high, so a single window is not evidence a permanent banner can rest on.
